title: YetAnotherDiscordIntegration (YADI)
description: YetAnotherDiscordIntergration - Link Discord chat with Minecraft Servers
body:
# YetAnotherDiscordIntegration

# Features

- Two-way chat bridging between a Minecraft server and a Discord channel.
- Execute Minecraft commands from Discord with a slash command.
- Display currently online players in the bot's status.

# How to setup

- Prepare a Discord application with MESSAGE_CONTENT intent enabled.
- Start the server once, then go to `config/yadi.toml` and insert the fields.
- Restart the server.
- Invite the bot with the link below (replace YOUR_CLIENT_ID with your application id)
- https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?permissions=2953964624&scope=bot%20applications.commands&client_id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID
